verdict.seen: Two round detectors on a wall, each with a dark chamber and a red-orange light beam across it, with smoke puffs rising above them. The left frame edge is orange.
A trash can with flames and rising smoke below a wall alarm with a beam. The smoke drifts past the alarm and a NO ALARM label appears.
The detector starts with only the beam. Then a blue sensor appears below the beam with a pale ray linking the beam to the sensor.
The room darkens across the three frames. The trash can burns and smoke rises past the alarm, which is labelled SILENT.
A brown horn disc appears at the top right of the detector and a red lamp appears at the bottom right, changing from orange to bright red.
The detector is fully built, but a large flat yellow square frame sits to the side and partly over it. It does not trace the alarm and it is cut off by the frame edge.
verdict.problem: The outline is a blocky yellow square offset from the alarm. Make a glowing outline that hugs the round detector and keeps it uncovered and fully in frame.

verdict.seen: A big black panel covers the alarm and shows a number counter that goes 0, 0, 6. A yellow bracket shows in frame one. It does not reach 10 and the alarm is hidden behind the panel.
verdict.problem: The counter never reaches 10 and the panel hides the alarm. Place the counter beside the alarm, clear of it, and count up to 10.

verdict.seen: The detector sits low in the frame and is partly cut off in the first two frames. A black slab covers part of it in the first frame. In the last frame it has a ring of vents, a gray button and a black battery piece.
verdict.problem: The detector is cropped and covered while the parts are added. Keep it centred and fully in view so the battery, button and vents are readable.

verdict.seen: The first frame shows the finished detector with vents, battery, button, horn and lamp. The next two frames pull back to an orange room wall, floor and a lawn, and the detector is no longer visible.
verdict.problem: The camera leaves the detector and shows only the room. Hold on the whole finished detector in view for the whole sentence.
